settings.heading: Check Your Order Upon Delivery
settings.content:
You are welcome to check your order while the courier is at your door to make sure everything is as expected.

If you decide to return the order after receiving and checking it, the return shipping fee will be paid by the customer.

settings.heading: If You Refuse the Order
settings.content: If you decide not to receive the order when the courier arrives, the shipping fee will still be charged to you, as the courier has already been dispatched for delivery.

settings.heading: Cancellation After Dispatch
settings.content:
If your order is already out for delivery and you decide to cancel it, a 75 EGP delivery/cancellation fee will apply.

This fee is charged due to the shipping company's policy and delivery costs.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
